target_insert: Will insert as a new section
abort_notice: Result discarded (the in-flight call will still finish on its own within 45s)
stale_section_notice: The section changed while waiting, so nothing was applied. Try again.
replace_conflict_new_section: The section changed after the AI read it, so the result was added as a new section instead of replacing it.
error_hint_no_key: The API key is missing or invalid.
error_hint_model_missing: The selected model could not be found.
error_hint_unreachable: Could not reach the AI server.
error_hint_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
error_hint_deadline: The response didn't arrive in time.
input_too_long_hint: Select a shorter section and try again.
preflight_ai_disabled_notice: AI is off, so this can't run. Turn it on in Settings > AI.
preflight_input_too_long_notice: The content is {{chars}} characters, over the {{cap}}-character limit. Select a single section and try again.
first_brief_text: Review the result and press Insert to change the note. To stop being asked every time, turn it off in Settings > AI > Permissions.
